corn_common_rust.summary: Improve field airflow. Monitor spread daily. Apply fungicide at first new lesions.
corn_common_rust.prevention: Keep canopy dry, monitor regularly, remove infected tissue promptly.

potato_early_blight.summary: Apply protectant fungicide. Remove lower infected leaves. Maintain dry canopy.
potato_early_blight.prevention: Keep canopy dry, monitor regularly, remove infected tissue promptly.

potato_healthy.summary: No disease detected. Continue monitoring every 3–5 days.
potato_healthy.prevention: Keep canopy dry, monitor regularly, remove infected tissue promptly.

potato_late_blight.summary: Act immediately — late blight spreads very fast. Apply systemic fungicide within 24h.
potato_late_blight.prevention: Keep canopy dry, monitor regularly, remove infected tissue promptly.
